acquisition_method: Data acquisition was executed in data dependent mode
alkylation_concentration: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide
alkylation_reagent: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide
cleavage_agent: and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion
fragmentation_method: followed by collision induced dissociation (CID) analysis of fragment ions in the ion trap
instrument: and analyzed with an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: For stable isotope labeling, Hela cells were cultured in DMEM medium for SILAC (Thermo fisher, cat # 88364)
mass_analyzer: full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer
reduction_concentration: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT
reduction_reagent: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT
